findings.title: C1 durable-pass allowed with activatedEvaluations=0 and empty receipts
findings.detail: derive() only checks len(receipts)!=activatedEvaluations. When both are 0, the check passes, and with verdictReceipt=present and policyVerdict=pass the result is durable-pass. Independent probe confirms. A golden with that shape would also pass RV4. This reintroduces a vacuous authoritative pass: no rule ran, yet C1 durable-pass is granted. G02 only covers activated=2 with zero receipts, not activated=0.
findings.requiredFix: For authoritative C1/C2, require activatedEvaluations>=1 OR an explicit sealed EmptyPlanProof / policy admitting empty evaluation set as a first-class decision (not silent durable-pass). Prefer: empty evaluation set → request-rejected PROOF.NO_ACTIVATED_EVALUATION or indeterminate unless Plan declares allowEmptyEvaluationSet with its own host-owned proof obligation.
findings.whatWouldChangeMyMind: A normative product rule that authoritative analysis with zero activated evaluations is a defined pass with a sealed empty-plan receipt that G0x already requires — currently no such receipt type or golden exists.

findings.title: derive() never reads evaluation outcomes; indeterminate/error receipts still allow durable-pass
findings.detail: inspect.getsource(derive) contains no 'outcome' check. Independent probes: all outcomes=indeterminate + policyVerdict=pass → durable-pass; outcome=error + no-match + pass → durable-pass. Prose VerdictReceipt invariant says a pass is invalid if required evaluation is insufficient; the executable derivation and goldens do not enforce it. Same class as D9 axes underdetermining codes: structural completeness ≠ semantic fidelity of the load-bearing claim.
findings.requiredFix: First-failure rules: any evaluation outcome indeterminate/error forces classification indeterminate (or policy-fail only if policy explicitly consumes proved-indeterminate under host obligation) and forbids durable-pass. Add goldens G20 (all indeterminate→not durable-pass) and G21 (error present→not durable-pass unless explicit policy path).
findings.whatWouldChangeMyMind: A documented rule that policyVerdict in the golden axes is already assumed consistent with outcomes and that outcome checking is out of scope for this runner — then RV4 must not claim to prove pass validity, only admission/graph completeness, and durable-pass goldens must be renamed to avoid overclaim.

findings.title: Checker proves mutual consistency of author-written axes and expected results, not independent scenario faithfulness
findings.detail: Author correctly states this in reviewPosture and knownLimitations. RV4 green is necessary, not sufficient. Zero-eval durable-pass can be co-authored and pass. Independent mutation that zeros G01 activations while leaving expected=durable-pass still exit 0 if both sides updated together — the trap that bit D9.
findings.requiredFix: Add non-author-controlled negative cases as hard invariants in the runner (activated>=1 for authoritative C1; forbid durable-pass when any outcome∈{indeterminate,error}) so they cannot be co-edited away without failing RV structural rules. Prefer second-author golden set for load-bearing cases.

findings.title: Outcome field is present on receipts but unused — false completeness signal
findings.detail: Axes schema requires outcome on every receipt, goldens fill it, derive ignores it. Readers and future implementers may assume outcome is load-bearing because it is required.
findings.requiredFix: Either wire outcome into derive (preferred, with A1-RTV3-02) or remove outcome from golden axes until a second pure function policyFromOutcomes exists and is tested.

findings.title: B-RTV2-05/09 measurement and crypto constructions correctly residual — do not seal over them
findings.detail: Author lists unmeasured custody sizes, unchosen authenticated-set construction, deletion unsolved, heuristic sync detection. Agree; these are seal blockers for ARCH.RETENTION-TIERS, not reasons to discard the v3 center.
findings.requiredFix: Keep as seal blockers; no new checker investment required for this class.
